goal: Allow out-of-process clients like a separate wallet to query chain state and receive notifications over IPC
reviewability: Review is paused waiting on the author to address an open objection
agreement: Broad concept and testing support for out-of-process chain access (darosior, Sjors, ariard, willcl-ark)
Verified by testing against external Rust wallet and Electrs implementations (darosior, Sjors)
Unaddressed objection: node aborts when client requests block hash past active chain tip (zaidmstrr)
Nonblocking objection: node segfaults if client passes null transaction data or unhandled enums (willcl-ark)

categories.name: ipc
why: P1 because it unblocks running the wallet in an isolated process (#10102)
Provides foundational IPC infrastructure needed by multiprocess Bitcoin Core architecture
